Overview

Latacunga is a city in X with a population of 100,000. A highland city near Cotopaxi volcano, known for its indigenous markets and traditional festivals. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
